title: Reader-feedback pilot through core blocks
description:
What: once Papyrus offers Vote, Rating and Comments blocks (Papyrus epic PPY-149b82), enable them on MoM's story and reference cards by configuration only, as the first non-Shipped site. Keep the platform design rules (icon plus text, no borders, colour-safe marks).
Acceptance:
Scenario: A reader can vote on a MoM story
  Given the Vote block is placed by configuration
  When a signed-in reader opens a story
  Then the vote control shows with an icon and a text label and records one vote
